last_verified.normal_state: Integrated the local structured diagnostics, verification report, privacy redaction, bounded crash capture seam, CLI commands, and DF-01 workstream health check on codex/integration-next-phase. 95 nagi-cli unit tests and 24 CLI integration tests pass; CLI and standalone bootstrap Clippy pass with warnings denied; both CLI and bootstrap lockfiles verify. Diagnostics, scoped verify, and host smoke produce passing host evidence. Workstream remains PARTIAL because the pre-integration --vm smoke attempt timed out in the existing M1/M7 QEMU guest boot check; it is separate from the strict M17 first-web-pixel gate. No target crash persistence or runtime authority was added. Public integration run 36228898043 has passed Ubuntu and Windows host jobs; target M17 QEMU acceptance is still running, so no target or M17 conclusion is recorded. The shared DF-01 validator now passes with 16 registered workstreams and 9 state files on the acceptance-runner integration head.

tests.name: Diagnostics and CLI test suite
tests.evidence: 95 unit tests and 24 CLI integration tests passed, including privacy redaction, event/report validation, CLI parsing, and registered DF-01 state validation.

tests.name: VM smoke guest boot (inherited pre-integration result)
tests.evidence: The QEMU guest boot check did not exit within the existing 30-second M1/M7 acceptance window. This is not M17 first-web-pixel evidence and no M17 PASS is claimed.

tests.name: Diagnostics source-branch Actions
tests.evidence: Run 36215571919 failed compiling nagi-bootstrap because the separate package omitted dependencies required by the shared CLI library. This integration adds the missing direct dependency and verifies the package locally.

ci_runs.summary: Integrated diagnostics head: Ubuntu and Windows host jobs passed; the target job remains in the independent M17 QEMU acceptance and has no result yet.
Source branch CI failed at the standalone bootstrap build due to missing direct dependencies for the shared diagnostics CLI library; fixed in the integration branch and checked locally.

release_line_gate.activation_requirement: This checkpoint provides host-side diagnostics contracts only. Guest crash persistence, target event collection, or production diagnostics service integration require Nagi 0.1 M30 PASS and an explicit release boundary.

do_not_try: Do not treat --vm smoke as evidence for the strict M17 first-web-pixel gate.
Do not add target crash persistence or guest event collection before its release gate.
Do not upload local diagnostics reports unless the user explicitly selects an output path.

next_action: Inspect root CI run 36232534175 for the integrated host and target workflow. Keep diagnostics host-local and PARTIAL while the inherited VM smoke timeout remains; do not change the existing guest acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Versioned structured events and reports enforce bounds, safe redaction, unique check IDs, and outcome derivation.
Registered health checks are scoped, continue after individual failures, and classify host versus VM evidence.
Diagnostics, verify, and host smoke commands pass with reports written only to an explicit output path.
When DF-01 is present, the workstreams health check reuses the authoritative nagi dev verify validator; when absent, it reports SKIPPED.
Crash capture remains a bounded portable contract and does not claim target persistence.
No diagnostics result changes M17 or any later milestone status without that milestone's acceptance evidence.
deferred: Target crash persistence and guest event collection until the relevant runtime boundary and release gate are available.
VM smoke success remains tied to the existing M1/M7 QEMU guest boot acceptance; it does not imply M17 first-web-pixel success.
Full JSON Schema validation with an installed schema validator was not run; syntax and implementation contract checks pass.

cross_workstream_dependencies.contract: Reuse the DF-01 registry and state validator through nagi dev verify, and align failure classes to the accepted durable-state vocabulary.
